elements.requirement: Capacity to buy and sell is regulated by the general law concerning capacity to contract and to transfer and acquire property.
elements.quote: Capacity to buy and sell is regulated by the general law concerning capacity to contract and to transfer and acquire property.

elements.requirement: A minor or a person who is incompetent to contract by reason of mental incapacity or drunkenness must pay a reasonable price where necessaries are sold and delivered to that minor or person.
elements.quote: Where necessaries are sold and delivered to a minor or to a person who by reason of mental incapacity or drunkenness is incompetent to contract, he must pay a reasonable price for them.

elements.requirement: In subsection (2), necessaries means goods that are suitable to the condition in life of the minor or other person concerned and to that person's actual requirements at the time of the sale and delivery.
elements.quote: “necessaries” means goods suitable to the condition in life of the minor or other person concerned and to his actual requirements at the time of the sale and delivery.
